'''John Edgar Ainsworth''' (June 28, 1920 – September 30, 2004)<ref name=SSDI /> was an American physicist and [[polymath]] who worked for [[NASA]].<ref name=post-obit /> Ainsworth was the primary designer of the [[Pioneer Venus Multiprobe|Pioneer Venus]] probe.<ref name=Goddard-obit />

== Personal life ==
Ainsworth, the son of Rev. John Edgar Ainsworth and Clara Eva Donsife, married Anne Elizabeth Kidder (1924–2015) on August 27, 1952, in [[Berkeley, California]]. Together, Anne and John had three children, Martha, Julie, and Paul. 

John Ainsworth died on September 30, 2004, aged 84, in [[Silver Spring, Maryland]].<ref name=SSDI />
